Name: moon_gate_place
name: The Moon Gate
description: The street's gate into the city; opens at dawn and shuts at dusk, the night watch relieved and carts queued outside counted in.

Name: gate_watch_post_place
name: The Gate Watch Post
description: Where the night watch mounts the wall and the three watches turn until dawn.

Name: market_square_place
name: The Market Square
description: The open square where the street's stalls set out each morning; the richest trade of the City of the Moon passes through here.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018); wb §5 (hub of trade and scholarship); notes L52

Name: stall_grain_place
name: Ea-nasir's Grain Stall
description: Grain and barley weighed out under an awning; the stall the temple's debt-collector is sent to, its keeper known for laughing at temple marks.

Name: stall_salt_oil_place
name: Waqurtum's Salt and Oil Stall
description: Salt from the southern marshes and pressed sesame oil sold by measure.

Name: stall_pottery_place
name: Baranamtarra's Pottery Stall
description: Plain wheel-thrown wares stacked for sale: jars, bowls, lamps.

Name: stall_cloth_place
name: Iltani's Cloth Stall
description: Woolen and linen cloth folded on the counter for the street's households.

Name: stall_produce_place
name: Matatum's Produce Stall
description: Dates, onions, garlic and leeks piled in baskets.

Name: cookshop_place
name: The Noon Cook-shop
description: Serves the noon meal to day-laborers, paid in bread and beer and barley.

Name: bakery_place
name: The Street Bakery
description: Clay ovens fired before dawn; the street's barley bread comes out at sunrise.

Name: brewery_tavern_place
name: The Reed-Straw House
description: A brewhouse and drinking room; beer fermented in great vats and drunk through reed straws, sacred to Ninkasi.

Name: temple_front_place
name: The Temple Front
description: The street-facing porch of the temple of sun and moon, where the morning and evening offerings are sung and passers-by leave small gifts.

Name: scribes_house_place
name: The Scribe's House
description: Home and workroom of the street's scribe; wet tablets dry in racks by the door.

Name: priestess_house_place
name: The Priestess's House
description: Home of the temple's priestess, who owes a debt she cannot be seen chasing down herself.

Name: bakers_house_place
name: The Baker's House
description: The baker's family home, warm with the smell of the ovens next door.

Name: millers_house_place
name: The Miller's House
description: The miller's family home, quern-dust on the threshold.

Name: potters_house_place
name: The Potter's House
description: The potter's home and yard, stacked with drying greenware.

Name: weavers_house_place
name: The Weaver's House
description: The weaver's home, a loom set up in the courtyard shade.

Name: elder_house_1_place
name: Huzalatum's House
description: A modest household headed by an elder of the street.

Name: elder_house_2_place
name: Amat-Shamash's House
description: A modest household headed by an elder of the street.

Name: street_well_place
name: The Street Well
description: Where the water-carriers draw the day's water at the coolest hour; every jar counted in the drought.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018); schedules.csv water_carriers_draw; wb §4.1 (the drought that is breaking the world)

Name: moon_niche_place
name: The Moon Niche
description: A small wayside niche facing the temple where residents leave offerings between the great rites.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018); wb §5 (temple of sun and moon); deities.csv nanna

Name: street_granary_place
name: The Street Granary
description: A small street-level granary holding the ration measure against the drought.

Name: great_lighthouse_place
name: The Great Lighthouse
description: The tower whose fire guides the ships of the sea lanes past the dark coast; the keeper takes harbor dues in barley and silver by weight at its foot.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-020); buildings.csv great_lighthouse (CANON); schedules.csv lighthouse_harbor_watch;lighthouse_fire_through_night; wb §5; notes L52

Name: lighthouse_wharf_place
name: The Lighthouse Wharf
description: The quays below the Great Lighthouse where the fishing boats put out on the morning tide and outbound cargo is carried down for the evening tide.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-020); schedules.csv fishermen_morning_tide;dockworkers_outbound_cargo; quests.csv errand_for_the_caravan_master;a_share_of_the_sea_lanes (the lighthouse wharf); dialogues.csv arrival_captain_verdict (the dockside below the Great Lighthouse); notes L52

Name: fields_beyond_the_gate_place
name: The Barley Fields
description: The barley and wheat fields along the river road outside the Moon Gate, hoed and hauled at first light while the air is still cool.
source_ref: INVENTED (D-018; D-020); schedules.csv field_hands_first_light; dialogues.csv breaking_retributor_of_utu (the river road below the moon gate); notes L57 (sowing wheat and barley)

Name: grazing_lands_place
name: The Grazing Lands
description: The grazing lands beyond the walls where the street's flocks are driven at first light and brought back through the gate to be counted before dark.

Name: physicians_house_place
name: The Physician's House
description: The asû's house: bundles of drying herbs under the eaves, jars of oil and plaster, a bench where the wounded are laid and bound.
source_ref: INVENTED (W4-B; D-018, D-021): the street's healer (kernel Combat treat_wounds 'healer'); ledger docs/proposals/invented-ledger-combat.md #7

Name: smithy_place
name: The Coppersmith's Forge
description: A walled yard with a clay furnace, bellows of goatskin and crucibles; blades are mended and broken bronze recast here.
source_ref: INVENTED (W4-B; D-018, D-021): repair and recasting of arms (kernel Combat repair/recast); ledger docs/proposals/invented-ledger-combat.md #7
